narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're embarking on an exciting journey to explore our incredible Solar System. By the end of this session, you will be able to clearly define what a solar system is, understanding its fundamental components. You will also learn to identify the key elements that make up our very own Solar System, from the central star to the planets and other celestial bodies orbiting it. Let's get started!
